paragraphs.source_en: Only after making up her mind did she release Nobuchika. She no longer had the leisure to dwell on how Nobuchika had been deceived by Nobumoto, or on Nobumoto’s cruelty toward her.

units.source_en: Only after making up her mind did she release Nobuchika.
units.source_zh: 她下定决心，方才放开了信近。

units.source_en: She no longer had the leisure to dwell on how Nobuchika had been deceived by Nobumoto, or on Nobumoto’s cruelty toward her.
units.source_zh: 对于信近被信元所骗，以及信元对她的残酷，她都已无暇顾及。

paragraphs.source_zh: 她下定决心，方才放开了信近。对于信近被信元所骗，以及信元对她的残酷，她都已无暇顾及。

paragraphs.source_en: When Okuni let go of him, Nobuchika finally breathed a sigh of relief. He hurriedly tried to sit up, only then remembering the wound in his leg; frowning, he gritted his teeth and rose to his feet. The wound was not grave, but the anguish in his heart cut far deeper than any wound he had ever suffered on the battlefield, piercing him to the marrow.

units.source_en: When Okuni let go of him, Nobuchika finally breathed a sigh of relief.
units.source_zh: 见於国放开了手，信近这才松了一口气。

units.source_en: He hurriedly tried to sit up, only then remembering the wound in his leg; frowning, he gritted his teeth and rose to his feet.
units.source_zh: 他急急地试图坐起身，突然想起腿上有伤，于是皱着眉头，咬紧牙关站了起来。

units.source_en: The wound was not grave, but the anguish in his heart cut far deeper than any wound he had ever suffered on the battlefield, piercing him to the marrow.
units.source_zh: 虽然伤势并不严重，但心中之苦远比以前在战场上受过的伤更深，痛彻骨髓。

paragraphs.source_zh: 见於国放开了手，信近这才松了一口气。他急急地试图坐起身，突然想起腿上有伤，于是皱着眉头，咬紧牙关站了起来。虽然伤势并不严重，但心中之苦远比以前在战场上受过的伤更深，痛彻骨髓。

paragraphs.source_en: Ashamed to be seen dragging a lame leg, he limped toward the moonlit space, preparing to leave the damp corridor. Just then, he heard someone open a door. “Lord Nobuchika.”

units.source_en: Ashamed to be seen dragging a lame leg, he limped toward the moonlit space, preparing to leave the damp corridor.
units.source_zh: 觉得拖着一只跛腿甚是丢脸，他一拐一拐走向有月光的地方，准备走出潮湿的走廊。

units.source_en: Just then, he heard someone open a door.
units.source_zh: 这时，他听到有人打开了门。

units.source_en: “Lord Nobuchika.”
units.source_zh: “信近公子。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 觉得拖着一只跛腿甚是丢脸，他一拐一拐走向有月光的地方，准备走出潮湿的走廊。这时，他听到有人打开了门。“信近公子。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Who is it?”

units.source_en: “Who is it?”

paragraphs.source_en: “I am the master of this establishment...”

units.source_en: “I am the master of this establishment...”
units.source_zh: “在下是敝处的主人⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下是敝处的主人⋯⋯”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hatarō?”

units.source_en: “Hatarō?”
units.source_zh: “波太郎？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “波太郎？”

paragraphs.source_en: Hatarō did not answer his question, but said calmly, “It is dangerous.”

units.source_en: Hatarō did not answer his question, but said calmly, “It is dangerous.”
units.source_zh: 波太郎没有回答他的问话，而是平静地说：“危险。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 波太郎没有回答他的问话，而是平静地说：“危险。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What danger? Could there be another ambush?”

units.source_en: “What danger?
units.source_zh: “什么危险？

units.source_en: Could there be another ambush?”
units.source_zh: 莫非还有埋伏？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “什么危险？莫非还有埋伏？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. Lord Nobuchika, you will be in danger if you continue as you are. This whole affair is monstrous.”

units.source_en: “No.
Lord Nobuchika, you will be in danger if you continue as you are.
units.source_zh: 信近公子，您这样下去很危险。

units.source_en: This whole affair is monstrous.”
units.source_zh: 此事令人发指。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不。信近公子，您这样下去很危险。此事令人发指。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What did you say?”

units.source_en: “What did you say?”
units.source_zh: “你说什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你说什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: With one foot lowered from the corridor and the other still upon it, Nobuchika raised his head and gazed at the moon in the sky.

units.source_en: With one foot lowered from the corridor and the other still upon it, Nobuchika raised his head and gazed at the moon in the sky.
units.source_zh: 信近一只脚迈下了走廊，另一只脚还在走廊上，抬头看着天上的月亮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信近一只脚迈下了走廊，另一只脚还在走廊上，抬头看着天上的月亮。

paragraphs.source_en: Okuni crouched motionless in a dim corner.

units.source_en: Okuni crouched motionless in a dim corner.
units.source_zh: 於国蜷缩在昏暗的角落，一动不动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 於国蜷缩在昏暗的角落，一动不动。

paragraphs.source_en: The moonlight grew ever brighter. Nobuchika stood there without moving. His own elder brother had plotted against him. To kill or be killed—the thought filled him with revulsion. Bathed in the silver moonlight, he appeared all the more desolate. He had to decide at that very moment which path he would take from then on.

units.source_en: The moonlight grew ever brighter.
units.source_zh: 月光越来越皎洁。

units.source_en: Nobuchika stood there without moving.
units.source_zh: 信近一动不动地站在那里。

units.source_en: His own elder brother had plotted against him.
units.source_zh: 他被自己的亲哥哥算计了。

units.source_en: To kill or be killed—the thought filled him with revulsion.
units.source_zh: 杀，还是被杀，一阵厌恶涌上心头。

units.source_en: Bathed in the silver moonlight, he appeared all the more desolate.
units.source_zh: 银色的月光照在他身上，越发显得凄凉。

units.source_en: He had to decide at that very moment which path he would take from then on.

ja.t: しなければならなかった。

paragraphs.source_zh: 月光越来越皎洁。信近一动不动地站在那里。他被自己的亲哥哥算计了。杀，还是被杀，一阵厌恶涌上心头。银色的月光照在他身上，越发显得凄凉。此后将何去何从，必须在这一刻作出决断。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuchika remained silent, gazing wordlessly at the moon above. He felt utterly alone, as though he were about to dissolve into its cold light.

units.source_en: Nobuchika remained silent, gazing wordlessly at the moon above.
units.source_zh: 信近依然不语，默默地看着天上的月亮。

units.source_en: He felt utterly alone, as though he were about to dissolve into its cold light.

ja.t: んでしまいそうだった。

units.source_zh: 他感到孤独，似乎要融入那清冷的月光。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信近依然不语，默默地看着天上的月亮。他感到孤独，似乎要融入那清冷的月光。

paragraphs.source_en: “What do you say? Why not give him what he wants—and let Tōkurō Nobuchika vanish from this world forever?”

units.source_en: “What do you say?
units.source_zh: “您意下如何？

units.source_en: Why not give him what he wants—and let Tōkurō Nobuchika vanish from this world forever?”

units.source_zh: 不如遂了他的愿——藤九郎信近从此在世间消失。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You mean to have that ninja take my place?”

units.source_en: “You mean to have that ninja take my place?”
units.source_zh: “你是想让那个忍者代替我？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是想让那个忍者代替我？”

paragraphs.source_en: “The Lord of Shimotsuke will believe his plan has succeeded.”

units.source_en: “The Lord of Shimotsuke will believe his plan has succeeded.”
units.source_zh: “下野守大人会以为自己的计划成功了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “下野守大人会以为自己的计划成功了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.”

units.source_en: “I see.”

paragraphs.source_en: “He means to kill Lord Nobuchika while branding Okuni an adulteress... Perhaps he will even claim that the man who had been secretly consorting with her was never Nobumoto, but Nobuchika...”

units.source_en: “He means to kill Lord Nobuchika while branding Okuni an adulteress... Perhaps he will even claim that the man who had been secretly consorting with her was never Nobumoto, but Nobuchika...”

paragraphs.source_en: “You mean he will spread such a rumor?”

units.source_en: “You mean he will spread such a rumor?”
units.source_zh: “你是说，他会散布这样的谣言？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是说，他会散布这样的谣言？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I venture to believe so.” Lowering his voice, Hatarō continued, “If Lord Nobuchika agrees to ‘die’ here and now, I shall arrange for Okuni to ‘die’ with you.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Lady Okuni as well—”

units.source_en: “Lady Okuni as well—”
units.source_zh: “於国小姐也——”

paragraphs.source_zh: “於国小姐也——”

paragraphs.source_en: “Has decided to go—”

units.source_en: “Has decided to go—”
units.source_zh: “决定去——”

paragraphs.source_zh: “决定去——”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuchika turned and walked away. The insects fell silent for a time, then began to sing again. The furious barking of the guard dog at the rear entrance announced that Nobuchika had safely reached the wicket gate.

paragraphs.source_en: From beyond the castle gate came the creaking of the drawbridge.

units.source_en: From beyond the castle gate came the creaking of the drawbridge.

paragraphs.source_zh: 城门外传来了吊桥吱吱呀呀的声音。

paragraphs.source_en: The moonlight grew colder and brighter, and beads of dew formed on the bush-clover leaves. When the drawbridge had been raised once more, nothing could be heard around them but the singing of insects.

units.source_en: The moonlight grew colder and brighter, and beads of dew formed on the bush-clover leaves.

units.source_en: When the drawbridge had been raised once more, nothing could be heard around them but the singing of insects.
